senses.gloss:
adv. m. (-रः)
1 Much, excessive.
noun.
2 A measure of value, two thousand Palas.
mfn. (-रः-रा or री-रं)
Who or what cherishes, upholds, supports, &c.
E.
भृ to cherish, अप् aff., or with घञ् aff. भार, q. v.

m. (-रः)
1 A weight of gold, equal to two thousand Palas.
2 A yoke for carrying burthens.
3 A name of VIṢṆU.
4 A weight, a burthen.
E.
भृ to nourish, aff. घञ्.

m. (-टः)
1 A potter.
2 A servant.
E.
भृ to cherish, Uṇādi aff. अटन्.

n. (-णं)
1 Cherishing, maintaining, nourishing, supporting.
2 Wages, hire.
3 The constellation Bharaṇī.
f. (-णी)
1 The name of the second lunar asterism, containing three stars, (Musca,) and figured by the pudendum muliebre.
2 A creeper, commonly Ghosha.
E.
भृ to nourish, ल्युट् aff.

m. (-भूः)
The personified ascending node or Rāhu.
E.
भरणी the asterism personified as a nymph, and भू born.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Fit or proper to be cherished or maintained, a dependant.
E.
भृ to nourish, अनीयर् aff.

m. (-ण्डः)
1 A master, an owner, a lord, a husband.
2 A sovereign, a king.
3 A king.
2 A bull.
E.
भृ to nourish, Uṇādi aff. अण्डन्.

mfn. (-ण्यः-ण्या-ण्यं)
To be cherished or protected.
n. (-ण्यं)
1 Wages, hire.
2 Cherishing, maintaining.
3 The asterism Bharaṇī.
f. (-ण्या)
A woman.
E.
भरण maintaining, and यत् aff.

mfn. (-भुक्)
A labourer, a hireling, one who works for hire.
E.
भरण्य wages or hire, भुज् to eat, aff. क्विप्.

f. (-ह्वा)
A plant, commonly Rāmadūtī.

m. (-ण्युः)
1 A master, a protector.
2 The sun.
E.
भृ to nourish, अन्यु aff.

mfn. (-रन्-रन्ती-रत्)
Upholding, supporting, having, cherishing.
E.
भृ to cherish, शतृ aff.

m. (-तः)
1 The younger brother of RĀMA.
2 The son of DUṢYANTA by ŚAKUNTALĀ.
3 The name of a sage or Muni,
4 The name of a celebrated writer on dramatic composition, of which he is also sometimes considered as the inventor; the term is also applied to his work, which appears to have been a body of Sūtras, or rules, relating to every branch of theatrical writing and exhibition; it is said to be lost, but is constantly quoted by the commentators on the Nāṭakas, or Indian dramas.
5 An actor, a dancer, a mime.
6 A barbarian, a mountaineer, a savage.
7 A weaver.
8 A descendant of BHARATA.
E.
भृ to nourish, अतच् Uṇādi aff.

n. (-तं)
1 Bhāratavarṣa or India proper, so called from BHARATA, the son of DUṢYANTA, whose patrimony it was. (E. भरत the prince, and अण् aff.)
2 The great sacred epic poem of the Hindus. (E. भार weight, त aff., भारत; having been put by the Ṛṣis in a scale, and weighed against the four Vedas which it was found to outweigh; thence its usual prefix of Mahā or great: a special grammatical rule, however, derives it from भरत the prince so named, because the war narrated in it occurred amongst his descendants.)
m. (-तः)
1 An actor, a mime.
2 A name of fire.
3 A descendant of BHARATA.
f. (-ती)
1 The goddess of speech.
2 Speech.
3 A quail.
4 A branch of the dramatic art, dramatic recitation or declamation, the delivery of the dialogue that is composed in elaborate Sanscrit stanzas.
E.
भरत the inventor of the Indian drama, aff. अण्; or the name of a sage, whose devotions brought the goddess SARASVATĪ from heaven; or again, भॄ to nourish, aff. अतच्, fem. aff. ङीप्.

m. (-कः)
An actor, a mime.
E.
भरत the dramatic author, पुत्त्र a son, and कन् aff. of comparison.

f. (-सूः)
A name of KAIKEYĪ, wife of DAŚARATHA, and mother of BHARATA.
E.
भरत as above, and प्रसू parent; hence equally applicable to ŚAKUNTALĀ, &c.

n. (-र्षं)
India.
E.
भरत the son of DUṢYANTA, and वर्ष region; he is supposed to have been the first emperor or monarch of all India.

m. (-जः)
A name of RĀMA.
E.
भरत, and अग्रज elder.

m. (-थः)
A sovereign, a king.
E.
भृ to nourish, aff. अथ्.

m. (-जः)
1 A skylark.
2 The name of a Muni.
3 The son of VṚHASPATI.
E.
भरत् upholding, and वाज a wing; also भारद्वाज.

m. (-जः)
1 A name of DROṆA, the military preceptor of the Kurus, and Pāṇḍus.
2 One of the seven Ṛṣis.
3 A name of the Muni AGASTYA.
4 The son of VṚHASPATI.
5 A skylark.
n. (-जं)
A bone.
f. (-जी)
Wild cotton.
E.
भरद्वाज a lark, and अण् pleonastick or derivative aff.; in the latter case it refers to a legend of the Ṛṣi BHARADVĀJA having been nursed by a lark, in consequence of being abandoned at his birth by his natural parents.

n. (-कः)
A lark.
E.
कन् added to the preceding.

mfn. (-तः-ता or ती-तं)
1 Green, of a green colour.
2 Nourished.
3 Filled.
E.
भृ to nourish, Uṇādi aff. उ.

m. (-मा)
Nourishing, cherishing.
E.
भृ to nourish, aff. इमनिच्.

m. (-रुः)
1 A name of VIṢṆU.
2 A name of ŚIVA.
3 Gold.
4 A husband, a lord.
E.
भृ to nourish, Uṇādi aff. उ.

m. (-जः)
A small sort of Shakal.

n. (-कं)
Fried meat.

m. (-र्गः)
1 A name of ŚIVA.
2 Light, lustre.
3 A name of BRAHMĀ.
4 Cooking, frying.
E.
भ्रस्ज to fry, aff. घञ्; having scorched KĀMADEVA to ashes, with a look.

n. (-नं)
Frying.
E.
भ्रस्ज to fry, aff. ल्युट्.

mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
To be cherished or maintained.
E.
भृ to nourish, aff. तव्य.

mfn. (-र्त्ता-त्त्री-र्त्तृ)
1 A cherisher, a nourisher, a protector.
2 A holder, a supporter.
m. (-र्त्ता)
1 A husband.
2 A lord, a master.
E.
भृ to nourish, &c. aff. तृच्.

f. (-घ्नी)
The murderess of her husband.
E.
भर्त्तृ a husband, हन to kill, aff. ङीष्, and घ्न substituted for the radical.

f. (-ता)
1 Masterhood.
2 Husbandship.
E.
तल् added to the last; also with त्व, भर्त्तृत्वं.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Subject, married.
E.
भर्त्तृता 2nd case, and गत gone.

m. (-कः)
A young prince, designated as successor, and associated to the empire, (in theatrical language.)
f. (-का)
(In theatrical language,) A princess.
E.
भर्त्तृ the master or monarch, and दारक the son.

m. (-रिः)
The brother of VIKRAMĀDITYA, A prince and poet.
E.
भर्त्तृ a prince, and हरि VIṢṆU, a deity amongst kings.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
Maintained, nourished, supported.
E.
भृ to nourish, क्ति aff. and मप् added.

r. 10th cl. (भर्त्सयति-ते)
To reprove, to reproach, to abuse or menace.

n. (-नं)
1 Threat, menace.
2 Reproach, abuse, cursing, reviling.
E.
भर्त्स to abuse, aff. ल्युट्.

r. 1st cl. (भर्भति)
To injure.

n. (-र्म्मं)
1 Gold.
2 Hire, wages.
3 The navel.
4 A particular coin.
E.
भृ to nourish, Uṇādi aff. मन्, whence it is properly भर्म्भन्, q. v.

f. (-ण्या)
Wages, hire.
E.
भर्म्भन् hire, यत् aff.

n. (-र्म्मं)
1 Wages, hire.
2 Gold.
3 The navel.
4 A coin, a piece of money.
E.
भृ to nourish, Uṇādi aff. मन्.

r. 1st cl. (भर्वति)
To hurt, to injure.

m. (-यः)
A lark.

f. (-ष्टिः)
A pole or yoke for carrying burthens; a stick carried over the shoulder, with strings attached to either end of it, forming at their lower extremity a noose, in which the articles to be conveyed are suspended.
E.
भार a burthen, and यष्टि a stick.

n. (-वं)
A bow-string.
f. (-वी)
Holy basil.
E.
भार a weight, वा to take, aff. क.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Loaded, burthened, bearing a burthen.
E.
भार, and मतुप् aff.

m. (-हः)
A porter, a bearer of burthens.
E.
भार a burthen, वह to bear, aff. अण्.

m. (-नः)
A beast of burthen, (as a camel, &c.)
n. (-नं)
A vehicle for burthens, a waggon.
E.
भार, and वाहन vehicle.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Carrying burthens.
m. (-कः)
A porter.
E.
भारवाह, and ठक् aff.

m. (-ही)
A porter.
E.
भार, and वाहिन् who bears.

m. (-विः)
The name of a poet, the author of the Kirātārjunīya.

m. (-क्षः)
A fragrant substance, commonly Kākṣi, considered variously as a vegetable or mineral product.

mfn. (-हः-हा-हं)
1 Able to carry loads.
2 Fit for the yoke.
E.
भार, and सह what bears.

m. (-रः)
A porter.
E.
भार a burthen, and हर who takes, from हृ with ट aff.; also with अण् aff. भारहार, and कन् added, भारहारक; or with घिनुण, भारहारिन्.

m. (-रः)
1 A porter.
2 Carrying a load.
E.
see the last.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Bearing a load, relating or referring to it, &c.
E.
भारहार, and ठक् aff.

mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं)
Loaded, laden, bearing a burthen.
f. (-न्ता)
A species of the Atyaṣṭi metre.
E.
भार, and आक्रान्त overcome.

m. (-रिः)
A lion.
E.
भॄ to threaten, aff. इन्.

m. (-कः)
A porter.
E.
भार a burthen, ठक् aff.

m. (-री)
A porter.
E.
भार a burthen, and इनि aff.

n. (-णं)
Taking up or bearing a burthen.
E.
भार, and उद्धरण taking up.

n. (-नं)
Bearing a load.
E.
भार, and उद्वहन up lifting.

m. (-वः)
1 A name of PARAŚURĀMA.
2 A name of ŚUKRA regent of VENUS, and preceptor of the Titans or demons.
3 An archer.
4 An elephant.
f. (-वी)
1 The goddess PĀRVATĪ.
2 The goddess LAKṢMĪ.
3 Bent grass, (Panicum dactylon, the Agrostis linearis of LINNÆUS; according to the Hindus, a black variety.)
E.
भृगु a Muni, the ancestor of PARAŚURĀMA, &c., and अण् aff. of descent.

m. (-यः)
The diamond.
E.
भार्गव ŚUKRA, and प्रिय fond of.

f. (-र्गी)
A shrub, (Siphonanthus Indica.)
E.
भर्ग BRAHMĀ, and अण् aff., sacred to that deity.

f. (-जी)
Wild cotton.
E.
a various reading of भारद्वाजी as above.

f. (-र्य्या)
A wife, espoused according to the ritual of the Vedas.
E.
भॄ to nourish, ण्यत् aff.

m. (-टः)
A man who lets out his wife for prostitution.
E.
भार्य्या wife, अट to go, aff. अच्; who lives by his wife.

m. (-कः)
1 A henpecked husband, one overruled by his wife.
2 A kind of deer.
E.
भार्य्या a wife, अट to go or be with, aff. अच्, भार्य्याट, and ठक् added.

m. (-मः)
1 Adultery.
2 Connubial intercourse.
E.
भार्य्या, and अतिक्रम approaching.

n. (-त्वं)
The condition or state of a wife.
E.
भार्य्या, and त्व aff.

m. dual only. (-ती)
Husband and wife.
E.
भार्य्या wife, and पति a husband.

m. (-रुः)
1 The name of a mountain.
2 A sort of deer.
3 The father of a child by another man's wife.
E.
भार्य्या a wife, ऋ to go to or with, उ aff.

m. (-ढः)
Married.
E.
भार्य्या, and ऊढ married.
